title: ID0412761-DC/SI-D/FR -[MP/R4 170001711]-DOOR ISSUE
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Hello, the door opening mechanism is out of order, making it impossible to open the door. Observation made on site with Siemens engineer Franck Le gal, only one of the door mechanisms is activated on the three. The video explains the problem.
Root cause:  repaired lock mechanism
Solution:
